name: StaticMiner
description: A CLI tool for analyzing and extracting HTML structures and CSS class selectors in legacy frontend projects.
author: Amilkar Díaz <amilkarjdiazh@outlook.com>

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('./exec', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('./exec', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:sea: pnpm run clean && pnpm run bundle && node --build-sea sea-config.json
